name: Can I trust the virtual renderings for pre-construction views?

mainEntity.name: Can I trust the virtual renderings for pre-construction views?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virtual renderings for pre-construction views provide an illustrative representation of what the finished view might look like. While they are a helpful guide, it's important to understand they are artistic impressions and may not perfectly reflect the final reality. Buyers should use them in conjunction with site plans, actual property surroundings, and expert advice to make an informed decision, acknowledging that minor discrepancies can occur.
acceptedAnswer.description: Virtual renderings are illustrative tools for pre-construction views; use them with site plans and expert advice as they are artistic impressions.
